authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. The current Planning Data Local plan boundary dataset contains polygons/multipolygons for areas covered by local plans and exposes stable boundary references and responsible organisation codes. Up to 50 records were considered as the bounded source window. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative local-plan-boundary reference/name, local-plan reference/name, organisation code, LPA/LAD identifier/name, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Therefore none of the official local-plan-boundary polygons can be bound to this slot without guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
